title: Matching Omega(k/eps) lower bound for the strict rank-k output is only cited

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**[proof-gap | MISSING LOWER BOUND]** `rem:scope`, `thm:lower`, `thm:pcp`.

The problem asks for sharpness of the sketch width $\ell$ for the **rank-$k$ output** $A_k^{\mathrm{rand}}$. But `thm:lower` addresses only the **projection** $P_YA$. The matching $\ell-k=\Omega(k/\varepsilon)$ converse for the rank-$k$ object is stated as 'the Clarkson-Woodruff communication lower bound, cited here' and is not proved.

Furthermore the proven Gaussian achievability for the clean guarantee is $O(k/\varepsilon^2)$ (`thm:pcp`), while the sharper $O(k/\varepsilon)$ is 'deferred to a chaining argument we do not reproduce.' So for the rank-$k$ object there is an unresolved $\varepsilon^{-1}$ vs $\varepsilon^{-2}$ exponent gap AND no proven lower bound. Part (a)'s 'sharp threshold + matching lower bound' is therefore established (modulo the separate `thm:lower` defect) only for the projection, not the rank-$k$ approximation.

**To close:** (i) reproduce the Clarkson-Woodruff $\Omega(k/\varepsilon)$ communication lower bound for rank-$k$ approximation; (ii) supply the sub-Gaussian chaining (Rudelson-Vershynin / Mendelson) upgrading plain-Gaussian $O(k/\varepsilon^2)$ to $O(k/\varepsilon)$.
